prompt: Design a gear-like disc in OpenSCAD by extruding a polygon profile. It has 12 teeth on a 30 mm root diameter and a 36 mm tip diameter, is 6 mm thick, and has a 6 mm bore through the centre. Build the toothed outline with a polygon() whose points you compute, not by unioning primitives, and phase the teeth so one tooth tip is centred on the +X axis. Each tooth occupies a 30 degree pitch: root until 8 degrees in, a flank out to the tip circle, a tip that spans 6 degrees, then a flank back to the root. Store the tooth count in a variable named teeth.
